title: Universal computation with magic Hamiltonians
summary: In the conventional theory of quantum computation, universality is discussed in terms of properties of unitary gate sets. In many experimental setups, however, we instead have access to a parametrized set of Hamiltonians, which can be exponentiated for any desired time. Accordingly, we formulate a continuous analogue of universality, where adding one expensive Hamiltonian control to a cheap set of local control operators allows for universal computation.
